policy: Keep a clear, prominent product or single worn garment at 60x80. Exclude collages, multiple competing products, flat print artwork without a clear product outline, promotional overlays, and unresolved gross product-type mismatches. Keep source labels unchanged; visual review does not assign Usage labels.
home_other_exclusion_reason: Multiple products or competing scene context in the same photo
party_extra_exclude_reason: Unresolved source product-type mismatch (6,7), or small top competing with full outfit at 60x80 (15,49,69)
party_model_context: A model wearing one prominent garment is allowed; retain the model-context flag for later analysis
abo_smart_casual: All source originals visually checked; deduplicate repeated product views before splitting
travel: Only the Flipkart singleton exact Occasion=Travel is admitted by the label gate; Amazon and ABO title/type/style phrases stay withheld
na: No compatible source label established; no images admitted
final_prepared_sheet_check: All 120 prepared PNGs were visually inspected alongside their originals in accepted_01.png through accepted_06.png; no clipping or new unsuitable images found
